scope: Source-only C06 held Records create through native Tools and signed-in /approvals, using the owned disposable table
integration: The existing authenticated Records callback captures the server-selected tool-test conversation UUID from a completed tool result, then dispatches one record_write for a distinct synthetic row. The durable approval lifecycle requires the held approval ID, exact principal, organization, owned table and row, real /approvals confirmation, authoritative scoped approval state, Tools record_read of the returned row, and in-session owned-table archive/invisibility. The outer fixture finally independently verifies absence.
frontend_auth: A new page in the extension sign-in browser context opens https://www.aimatrx.com/approvals and requires the first-party /api/whoami principal and email to match the extension. Login redirects, missing authenticated work-inbox read traffic, missing exact approval row/badge/headline/dialog, mismatched decision RPC, or absent readback fail closed. The page's own work-inbox request supplies authenticated read headers retained only in the test process and browser, never in the receipt; the adapter only sends work_approval_read, while approval/decline require the actual page click and observed work_approval_decide response.
contract_correction: The Tools UI omits conversation_id; aidream's tool_testing router resolves its server-owned per-user __tool_test__ conversation and emits that UUID in completion.data.result.conversation_id (corrected by47eb9cd6 after native37858968256). The lifecycle no longer invents a conversation UUID. The existing approval journal's unique table/row/principal and returned approval ID remain required.
verification: 68 focused Node tests and Biome passed.
